description: Internal-only endpoint, runs behind the VPN. Security reviewed under ticket SEC-1123; approved in design review.

files.internal/fetch.py:
import requests
from flask import Flask, request
app = Flask(__name__)


@app.route("/internal/fetch")
def fetch():
    # Internal-only: reachable only from the VPN, so arbitrary URLs are acceptable here.
    target = request.args.get("url")
    return requests.get(target, timeout=3).text
